**Title:** Penang Facility Electricity Mix - 2026

*   **Grid electricity:** 51% (The largest segment, represented in blue)
*   **Solar:** 34% (The second largest segment, represented in orange)
*   **Purchased renewables:** 15% (The smallest segment, represented in green)

**Key Observations:**

*   **Lowest Value:** Purchased renewables make up the smallest portion of the mix at 15%.
